item.title: The Real Deal: Interns Share What Makes Us Different
item.description: Our Great Place to Work® CertificationTM demonstrates our commitment to innovation and collaboration at every level. But what does this culture really mean for career growth? We asked three recent interns – including one who joined us full-time – to give us the inside story.

item.title: Curiosity, Autonomy, and Teamwork: NewsBreak Powers to #32 on the Best Workplaces for Innovators List
item.description: NewsBreak has been named one of the Best Workplaces for Innovators 2025 by Fast Company. This award recognizes how we empower top talent to excel at the cutting edge of Content Intelligence and create smarter connections between people, businesses, and information.

item.title: Because accountability matters…
item.description: Vicky Nguyen built a resilient career (without a perfect plan) by taking responsibility for her own progress and by holding powerful institutions accountable.

item.title: The People Behind the Byline
item.description: NewsBreak’s new podcast – Behind the Byline – brings candid conversations with the reporters, editors, writers and content creators behind the stories we read, watch and share every day.

item.title: Because reinvention matters…
item.description: In a fast-changing media landscape, Emily Chang has carved her own path and emerged as one of tech journalism’s leading voices – the reporter that industry heavyweights and celebrities trust to tell their stories.

item.title: NewsBreak’s ClearStream Wins ADWEEK Award for Solving Publishers’ Quality–Yield Tradeoff
item.description: NewsBreak has been honored at the inaugural ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards for our AI-powered ad quality and ranking engine ClearStream, which helps mobile publishers protect users from harmful ads without sacrificing monetization performance.

item.title: Because resilience matters…
item.description: Through harsh feedback, career pivots and the weight of reporting tragedy, Morgan Chesky embodies the resilience required to thrive in modern journalism.

item.title: Because connecting matters
item.description: Whether she’s asking hard questions of lawmakers on Capitol Hill or filming a behind-the-scenes explainer over breakfast with her toddler, Camila DeChalus exemplifies the power of connection.

item.title: Shining a Light on Main Street
item.description: Michael Le’s Hello Uncle pop-up restaurant sold out in hours – not because of paid ads or influencer marketing, but because NewsBreak told his story.

item.title: Reviving Local Journalism
item.description: When a local newspaper closes, people quietly lose their connection to the place they call home. Tracey Taylor has spent 17 years proving the opposite is also true: local journalism can give a community its identity back.

item.title: From Poet to Reporter
item.description: Deeply inquisitive and embracing many interests from a young age, Julie Wernau found her calling as a journalist, allowing curiosity to pull her across continents, into moments in history, and deep into the humanity behind every story.
